Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Dunbar Modern Dining Room Set of 2 Ladderback Side Kitchen Chairs, 38 Inch Height, Oak Wood
Colors: Beige
Materials: Textile
This handsome ladder-back chair is a modern take on a classic design. Solid hardwood and performance fabric upholstery on the seat, allowing it to withstand wear and tear from a busy family. 20"W x 23.25"D x 38"H Solid hardwood frame and performance fabric A simple modern piece with rustic and modern influences Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Assembly is required. Wipe with soft dry cloth.
